title: Typhoon Queenie intensifies while about to exit PAR

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Typhoon Queenie (international name: Surigae) has further intensified but is already about to exit the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR), the state weather bureau reported on Sunday. In its 11 a.m. weather bulletin, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Queenie is now packing a maximum sustained wind speed of 150 kilometers per hour (kph) near the center (up from the 130 kph in the 5 a.m. forecast) and gustiness of up to 185 kph (up from 160 kph).
